# autops

> autops is an AI MCP for solo builders, non-developers, and vibe coders who need to understand and operate the services they build. Its goal is to take on DevOps work as a solo-built service grows toward 100,000 monthly active users; that scale is a vision, not a verified current capability.

Current capabilities: connect a GitHub account and selected repository, read authorized source files through the ChatGPT MCP connection, make reviewed single-file source updates with explicit write authorization, and view selected Vercel or Supabase project status. Live API diagnostics work only for the public compiled-ex-project demo.

The homepage explains why autops exists and how to start: connect a project, connect autops in ChatGPT, and ask about the service. Deployment requests require cloud.deploy and separate project-specific approval. Demo diagnostic history and comparison are available. Scheduling is owned by the calling client, such as ChatGPT or Claude; autops has no scheduler or cron jobs. Billing and time-based access limits are not active.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://autops-app.vercel.app/): Product purpose, three-step setup, ChatGPT connection details, and current capabilities.
- [Project README](https://github.com/ongleam/autops/blob/main/README.md): Full user guide, example requests, troubleshooting, and current limitations.
